sentences.text: A small study reported it among eight gut microorganisms with diagnostic significance when comparing healthy people, people with type 2 diabetes mellitus and people with type 2 diabetes and coronary atherosclerotic heart disease.
An in vitro study of disaccharides reported that beta-disaccharides enhanced Paraprevotella clara proliferation.
Cell-free supernatant from a Paraprevotella clara strain was among those that reduced the swine pathogen Brachyspira hyodysenteriae in vitro.
